name: STASIS EURO

regulatory_status.status: Not authorized — reportedly removed from ESMA's MiCA Electronic Money Token register after STASIS suspended new EURS issuance in 2024. This status is sourced from secondary reporting, not a direct primary-source read of the ESMA register, and should be independently reconfirmed.

description: A euro-backed stablecoin issued by STASIS. New issuance has been suspended since 2024 and on-chain activity has declined materially (~88% drop in monthly transfer volume as of mid-2026); treat as a legacy, wind-down-adjacent asset rather than an actively growing stablecoin.
